name: GlobalLink Connect for Drupal
description: TMGMT translator plugin that sends translation jobs to the GlobalLink (translations.com) Project Director service over its SOAP API and imports the completed translations.
project_description:
Introduction 

 This module connects Drupal 8.x and 9.x to Translations.com's translation management system, GlobalLink. You will need a Translations.com account to connect your Drupal site to their GlobalLink product. Additionally, the Drupal 8.x and 9.x integration relies on integration via the Translation Management Tool module ( found here ). 

 GlobalLink® Connect for Drupal 

 GlobalLink Connect provides an all-in-one solution to initiate, automate, control, track, and complete all facets of the translation process. The unique combination of Drupal and the extended localization workflow capabilities of GlobalLink provide Drupal users with a comprehensive solution for managing global enterprise content with minimal effort and virtually no IT overhead. When combined with GlobalLink AI, Drupal users cut costs and time-to-market even further while still maintaining a high quality. 

 Features 

 
 Seamless Integration - Scheduled or on-demand translation via the UI. 
 On-Demand Analytics - Get a dashboard view of translation spend and other KPI’s. 
 Vendor Management - Use internal or external translation resources. 
 Flexible Workflows - Use machine translation, human translation, or both. 
 Rapid ROI - Reduce IT involvement and eliminate project management overhead. 
 
 Installation 

 
 Drupal 8.x and 9.x 

Do not use manual download for installation. Use Composer to download all dependencies.

 composer config repositories.drupal composer https://packages.drupal.org/8

composer require drupal/globallink
